effects.effect: The next strike made against the target gains an edge.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The target [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to their speed.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The ghost chooses one additional target.

features.name: Haunt
features.target: Self or one ally with a Phasing trait

effects.effect: The ghost halves the damage from the strike and the target takes 2 sonic damage.
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Shriek
features.trigger: A creature within distance targets the ghost with a strike.

effects.effect: Each undead with a Phasing trait within 10 squares of the ghost can't be made [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) or [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened).
Each target rises 1 square into the air and is vertically [pulled](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 5 squares toward the nearest enemy within 3 squares of the target.
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Paranormal Activity
features.target: Each size 3 or smaller object in the area

effects.tier3: P < 3 the target is levitated until the end of the encounter

effects.effect: A levitated target floats 1 square off the ground when first affected, then rises 1 square at the end of each of their turns. If a levitated target can't already [fly](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/fly), they can [fly](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/fly) but are [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) and [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened) while flying this way.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: A target who has P < 2 is reduced to 1 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) if they are [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded) after taking this damage.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The ghost can move through creatures and objects at their usual speed, but can't end their turn inside a creature or object. The first time in a round that the ghost moves through a creature, that creature takes 2 corruption damage. At the start of any undead's turn, you can spend [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice) to activate one of the following features.

> 🌀 **Ravenous Horde (2 [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice))**
>
> At the end of this round, each hero not already [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to one or more undead is beset by two **rotting zombies** who burst up from the ground to appear in adjacent unoccupied spaces. Each zombie is [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded). This feature can't be used two rounds in a row.

> 🌀 **Paranormal Fling (3 [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice))**
>
> Up to three unattended objects on the encounter map rise to float 1 square off the ground. Each object is then [pulled](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 5 squares toward the nearest enemy within 3 squares of the object.

> 🔳 **The Grasping, the Hungry (5 [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice))**
>
> Ravenous and rotting undead arms burst forth from 9 connected squares of a vertical or horizontal surface. Any creature who ends their turn [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to an affected square makes an **Agility test**.
>
> - **≤11:** 5 damage; [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
> - **12-16:** 5 damage; [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (EoT)
> - **17+:** 5 damage
>
> **Effect:** While [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) this way, a creature takes 1d6 damage at the start of each of their turns.

> ⭐️ **Dread March (7+ [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice))**
>
> Up to four undead in the encounter move up to their speed and can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike). The number of undead affected increases by 1 for each additional [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice) spent on this feature. If an undead is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) during this dread march, they don't die until the march is resolved.

> Ravenous and rotting undead arms burst forth from 9 connected squares of a vertical or horizontal surface. Any creature who ends their turn [adjacent](../../../rule/combat/adjacent.md) to an affected square makes an **Agility test**.
>
> - **≤11:** 5 damage; [restrained](../../../condition/restrained.md) (save ends)
> - **12-16:** 5 damage; [restrained](../../../condition/restrained.md) (EoT)
> - **17+:** 5 damage
>
> **Effect:** While [restrained](../../../condition/restrained.md) this way, a creature takes 1d6 damage at the start of each of their turns.

> ⭐️ **Dread March (7+ [Malice](../../../rule/monster/malice.md))**
>
> Up to four undead in the encounter move up to their speed and can make a [free strike](../../../feature/common/main-actions/free-strike.md). The number of undead affected increases by 1 for each additional [Malice](../../../rule/monster/malice.md) spent on this feature. If an undead is reduced to 0 [Stamina](../../../rule/health/stamina.md) during this dread march, they don't die until the march is resolved.
